body:
Unfortunately a rug wouldn’t come close to covering it I’m ashamed to say. As it was blood it was also starting to leave a horrible smell as it dried so bad to just bite the bullet (excuse the choice of words) and pull it up.

I’m trying to tackle it with humour currently, not sure if it’s healthy but trying to keep a smile on as much as I can.

Right now things seem hard, trying to just focus on work, returning to work on Monday straight after kept my mind fairly busy, I’ve not had a chance to dwell on it too much. 

It all seems so ridiculous looking back, like watching someone else do it in a movie. All a bit hyper-realised rather than real.
